Meteorology

Bassa Pressione

An area of the atmosphere where the pressure is lower than that of the surrounding region, often associated with unsettled weather, precipitation, and potential turbulence.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Bassa Pressione?

In this glossary, Bassa Pressione refers to: An area of the atmosphere where the pressure is lower than that of the surrounding region, often associated with unsettled weather, precipitation, and potential turbulence.

How is Bassa Pressione used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Informare i piloti di un sistema di bassa pressione in sviluppo con potenziale turbolenza lungo la rotta di avvicinamento."

Why does Bassa Pressione matter in aviation?

Bassa Pressione matters because it supports clear communication in Meteorology contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Bassa Pressione?

Bassa Pressione is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Bassa Pressione belong to?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition
